run_preprocessing_slurm_array: run the SLURM array job script to preprocess 3D scene data in parallel
run_jobarray_entrypoint: run the jobarray entrypoint function to preprocess scenes between start and end indices
submit_preprocessing_jobs: submit parallel preprocessing jobs to a SLURM cluster using submitit AutoExecutor
partition_scene_indices: partition scene start and end indices across multiple SLURM array jobs
configure_slurm_executor: configure a submitit AutoExecutor with SLURM QoS, account, GPU, and memory parameters
